notes.title: "SECRET BUNKER" DLC LAUNCH

The "[b]SECRET BUNKER[/b]" DLC, the largest DLC in terms of pieces to date, is officially released for [b]Diorama Builder[/b].

It's a DLC full of details, where in every corner of the diorama you'll find something amazing to build and then interact with.

[h3]Can you build this huge and detailed BUNKER?[/h3]

[list] [*][b]1855 Pieces:[/b] Build various environments of this mega BUNKER, such as the dormitory, control room, gym, and even the exterior, with its exploration bus.

notes.title: RELEASE date announcement + super pre-launch DISCOUNT for Diorama Builder
notes.content:
[h2]From 13 to 19/06 with 60% discount, before the price increase[/h2]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35020302/9b1124ee0d5c8688d9e79686fa2a76c0f81cc649.png[/img]

[u][b]Hello fellow Diorama builders[/b][/u]

The wait is almost over - the release of the final version of "[u][b]Diorama Builder[/b][/u]" arrives on [u][b]June 20, 2024[/b][/u]! Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into an even more complete diorama-building experience, including the 3 DLCs that will be released on the same day.

[h2]SUPER DISCOUNT OF 60% PRE-LAUNCH OF "DIORAMA BUILDER"[/h2]

For those who are POSTPONING the purchase of DIORAMA BUILDER and in the name of transparency, we will be increasing the price for the LAUNCH of the FINAL VERSION, so to encourage them, between the 13th and 19th of May 2024, we will give a super discount of 60%!

[h3][b]>>> Don't miss this opportunity, BUY Diorama Builder now! <<<[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1370170/Diorama_Builder/

[h2]WHAT'S NEW IN THE FINAL VERSION?[/h2]

We've been working hard to polish and perfect Diorama Builder, and we're excited to reveal a host of new features and improvements in the final release:
[list]
[*][u][b] Catalog of native dioramas and DLCs[/b][/u]
Easily browse and manage your collection of dioramas (including the DLCs).

[*][u][b] Shelf organization system[/b][/u]
Keep your diorama shelf organized and stocked with the dioramas you like most and are currently assembling.

[*][u][b] Stamps to divide the different dioramas into categories[/b][/u]
Presentation of a SEAL for each diorama, determining its series for better identification.

[*][u][b] Axis visual system for better camera control[/b][/u]
A new system to locate the center of the XYZ axes and thus be able to have greater control of the camera (rotation and zoom) at the desired point or object.

[*][u][b] Option to hide/show Diorama pieces from any folder[/b][/u]
Turn on/off the visibility of diorama folders (parts) for a more focused view.

[*][u][b] New system for going down and up certain walls (for dioramas with this feature)[/b][/u]
Move down and up certain walls of the dioramas with this feature, in a simpler and more intuitive way, to better appreciate the diorama's internal spaces.

[*][u][b] News feed[/b][/u]
Stay up to date on the latest news and announcements from Diorama Builder.

[*][u][b] Improved help system[/b][/u]
Find assistance quickly and easily with the improved help system.

[*][u][b] Visual, UI, and UX improvements[/b][/u]
Experience improved visuals and a smoother, more intuitive user experience.

[*][u][b] Performance Improvements[/b][/u]
Enjoy more stable and responsive gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]ABOUT THE DLCS[/h2]

Expand your diorama collection with the DLCs that will come out with the final version.
Don't leave it for later, add them to your WISHLIST now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2777580/Diorama_Builder__Noir_City/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668590/Diorama_Builder__Medieval_Castle/

[quote]NEW DLC TO BE ANNOUNCED SOON AND RELEASED TOGETHER WITH THE FINAL VERSION OF THE GAME[/quote]

Thank you and follow our page to stay up to date with upcoming announcements and news!
https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/virtualartsstudio

All the best, to everyone, always!

notes.title: First Patch of the Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079985/ee2ad595916beb20129b2799f6e804c09c789b2b.jpg[/img]

Hello, Hamster Friends!

First of all, we want to express our immense gratitude to all players who dedicated their time to report issues or simply interact with us. Thanks to your feedback, we have been able to identify and resolve various issues in the Steam version of the game.

We are working to implement these fixes on other platforms as soon as possible.

We are immensely grateful for your continuous support in our mission to save the Hamster Kingdom ❤️.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Resolved the error that allowed the Hamster to travel on the same track both to and fro.
[*] Fixed the bug that deactivated the buttons on the Left Side Panel after completing the tutorial.
[*] Eliminated the bug that allowed the Hamster to pass by NPCs without delivering the Task and, upon passing again with the Task item, the NPC did not interact with the Hamster.
[*] Solved the problem that prevented unlocking certain elements in the HELP panel.
[*] Corrected the issue where, after completing the HELP panel tutorial (H), pressing H again resulted in the dialogue repeating.
[*] Resolved the bug that prevented Departure the first phase of a new world after placing all the pieces.
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented opening a Chest after interacting with a piece that redirected the Hamster's path, like the Redirection Rail piece.
[*] It is now possible to enable achievements related to the completion of the worlds.
[*] Corrected various minor visual errors to improve the gaming experience.
[*] Adjustments made in some systems to ensure they function as expected.
[/list]
We will continue monitoring and improving the game, always aiming to provide the best possible experience for our players. Thank you again for your support and patience.

Happy adventures in the Hamster Kingdom!

notes.title: Award-Winning Puzzle Game “Hamster on Rails” is arriving
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079985/102ed5deb269a0bdd1bfb11749720ee9701cbc28.png[/img]

Hey everyone! We would like to tell you about our nomination at GDC.

"Hamster on Rails" won the prestigious "Best in Play" award at the 2023 Game Developers Conference (GDC) in San Francisco, USA, held in March. Out of numerous contenders, "Hamster on Rails" was in a select group of only eight games to be honored with this relevant award that recognizes the future of the electronic gaming industry. 

In “Hamster on Rails”, players join the best and bravest railway builder on an amazing journey to search for precious minerals and save the Hamster Village. With charismatic characters, this fun and challenging puzzle game will put players’ skills to the test. The game offers the excitement of building unusual railways, helping other hamsters, customizing the hero, and saving the village of hamsters.

“The recognition of ‘Best in Play’ at GDC further validates the incredible talent and passion of the team at Virtual Arts Studio, and we can’t wait for players to experience the excitement and challenge of this amazing game", said Andre Freitas, CEO of DX Gameworks. 

The official release of “Hamster on Rails” is coming soon, and players are encouraged to add the game to their Wishlist and Follow it on Steam to stay updated with the latest news and developments of this game suitable for all ages.
